name: ☢️ +1 Speed Keyboard: Escape the Backrooms
desc:
🚪 Escape the Backrooms while gaining +1 Speed every second! Run faster, unlock new areas, avoid terrifying monsters, and reach the final exit before it's too late. Collect Wins, rebirth to become even stronger, and discover hidden secrets throughout the Backrooms. Can you escape every level?

⭐ Features:

⚡ +1 Speed Every Second
👹 Scary Backrooms Monsters
🏃 Unlock Faster Speeds
🏆 Collect Wins
🔄 Rebirth System
🔓 New Areas to Explore
🎮 Keyboard Controls
👥 Play with Friends
